Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide 16:9 loading-screen background illustration for the PC game Tidal Reclaim, landscape 1536x864 or larger.
Primary request: an art-directed retro industrial robot maintenance poster, restrained and graphic, NOT generic AI sci-fi key art.
Input image: reference only, showing the actual cream and burnt-orange patrol robot and cylindrical water purifier. Ignore its UI, text, composition and screenshots. Preserve the robot's recognisable boxy cream head with one dark round sensor, compact cream torso, burnt-orange shoulder plates, forearms and boots, exposed dark mechanical joints.
Composition: left 43 percent is calm warm off-white paper, nearly empty for real UI typography to be added later. Right half contains a large cropped three-quarter bust of that robot, head around x=76%, y=35%, shoulders reaching bottom edge. A single muted teal disc and a very thin technical registration line behind it, small restrained burnt-orange panel as visual counterweight. Illustration stays in the right half; never fill the left with mechanical detail.
Style: collectible Japanese industrial-design handbook meets hand-painted European sci-fi comic cover; crisp considered silhouette, confident slightly imperfect ink contours, flat gouache colour shapes, sparing cel shading, subtle screenprint grain, real designed asymmetry. Mechanical design is plausible, simple and legible with only a few panel seams and bolts; lived-in paint at edges rather than random dirt. Mature, tactile, charming utilitarian robotics.
Palette: warm ivory #e7e1cf, deep petroleum teal #183f43, muted sage #91aaa0, burnt orange #b85b3c, charcoal. Soft daylight, no glossy 3D render, no cinematic lighting.
No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI boxes, fake HUD, cables everywhere, neon, glowing eyes, lens flare, bokeh, photorealism or hyperdetail. Opaque full-bleed background.

Create a new wide environmental illustration for Tidal Reclaim's main menu in EXACTLY the tactile editorial screenprint / ink-and-gouache visual language of image 1. Mature industrial robotics, clean readable shapes, lightly worn paint, restrained mechanical detail. Match the ivory, petroleum teal, muted sage, burnt-orange and charcoal palette.
The LEFT 45% is quiet warm ivory paper reserved for live title/menu typography. In the RIGHT 55%, an offshore water reclamation platform with cream cylindrical purification tanks, dark teal pipes, rust-orange railings and steel walkways above a flat teal sea. A full-body version of the same small single-lens box-headed cream and orange robot stands on the near deck at x=77%, about 50% of the image height; relaxed alert three-quarter pose, hands lowered, distinct mechanical fingers, no weapon required. The head has one black circular camera aperture and an orange shoulder on each side. A few large simple industrial forms and two distant wind turbines give clear depth, with a pale overcast sky. Deck forms should connect physically and have plausible perspective, no labyrinth of random pipes. Calm evocative atmosphere, a working sea outpost, no battle/explosions.
Graphic composition with a clean ivory negative-space field on the left flowing into the pale sky; keep the character and all high contrast equipment to the right of x=48%. No frame, no card, no UI, no text, no tiny fake lettering, no watermark. Hand-designed collectible game box illustration, avoid glossy 3D, photorealism, cinematic teal-orange lighting, neon, fog glow, lens flare, photobashing, infinite microdetail.
